# Reference — Levels & progressive unlock

> **Diátaxis: Reference.** The ten operator ranks, the XP each requires, and what
> each level-up reveals. NeuroVim is **Story-Mode**: content unlocks as you rank up.

## Ranks

| Level | Rank | XP required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **SIGNAL LOST** | 0 |
| 2 | **GHOST OPERATOR** | 66 |
| 3 | **DEEP COVER** | 186 |
| 4 | **NEON WRAITH** | 371 |
| 5 | **CHROME RAVEN** | 601 |
| 6 | **SIGNAL HUNTER** | 800 |
| 7 | **PROTOCOL READER** | 1150 |
| 8 | **PATTERN BREAKER** | 1550 |
| 9 | **CIPHER ANALYST** | 2000 |
| 10 | **SIGNAL ARCHITECT** | 2500 |

You start at **Level 1 — SIGNAL LOST** with the first chapter unlocked. XP comes
from completing missions (`xp_reward` per mission); crossing a threshold ranks you up
and reveals that level's missions and loot.

## What each level-up unlocks

| Reaching level | Unlocks missions | Unlocks loot |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 | `M-05`, `M-06`, `M-07`, `M-08`, `KATA-02`, `KATA-03`, `KATA-12` | `LOOT-01` |
| 3 | `M-09`, `M-10`, `M-11`, `M-12`, `KATA-04`, `KATA-13` | `LOOT-02` |
| 4 | `M-13`, `M-14`, `M-15`, `KATA-05` | `LOOT-03` |
| 5 | `M-16`, `KATA-06`, `R-01`, `R-02`, `R-03`, `R-04` | `LOOT-04` |
| 6 | `R-05`, `R-06`, `R-07`, `R-08`, `KATA-07`, `KATA-14` | `LOOT-05` |
| 7 | `R-09`, `R-10`, `R-11`, `R-12`, `R-13`, `R-14`, `R-15`, `R-16`, `KATA-08`, `KATA-09` | `LOOT-07` |
| 8 | `R-17`, `R-18`, `R-19`, `R-20`, `KATA-10` | `LOOT-08` |
| 9 | `R-21`, `R-22`, `R-23`, `R-24`, `KATA-11` | `LOOT-06` |
| 10 | — | `LOOT-09` |

Mission IDs: `M-xx` story missions, `R-xx` later-arc operations, `KATA-xx` free
drills, `LOOT-xx` lore artifacts. See the [Vim keymap](vim-keymap.md) for the
commands each chapter teaches.
